mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies around Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 71 degrees under a new moon.

The city has published official notices for the fall elections, and please note that road construction on Highway M is scheduled to begin August 18, involving lane shifts and utility work over the next few weeks.
There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee, plus trivia options at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
On August 8, officers assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office with an in-progress burglary where a drone was used to locate a suspect who had fled into a corn field.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Covered Strawberry. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
